variants.name: .308 Win.
variants.info:
Uses .308 Winchester, a stronger round with higher bullet speed, penetration, improved damage ranges and better head/torso damage!
Slight increase in camera recoil but also exclusively uses 10 round magazines, you will however get better walk speed, handling and a faster reload!

variants.name: Extended Magazine
variants.info:
A 30 round magazine for your FAL! Allowing it to last longer in battle but your reload time will be even longer than it already is!
Lower walkspeed, reserve and handling!

variants.name: Drum Magazine
variants.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you a significant amount of ammo but reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling!

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

variants.name: XM155 'SILENT'
variants.info:
An experimental military cartridge designed to improve suppressor function by reducing the velocity of the round to subsonic levels, thereby eliminating the telltale supersonic crack. The round is also heavier, providing better overall energy retention at range - just watch the drop!

Suppressor masking ranges are significantly better with this round!

variants.name: 10rd Mag
variants.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .243 Win.
variants.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .243 Win.
A shorter round popular for sport shooting with a higher muzzle velocity, lower recoil and improved damage over distance at the cost of weaker close range performance and penetration.
